messages:
anna: quick heads-up, noticed a tail-latency bump on short-seq (2-32) requests after yesterday's autotune merge. looks like the pick moved to the fallback matmul path on Ampere for seq_bucket=8. dumping telemetry + sample logs below.

anna: telemetry snapshot: pick_reason=autotune_epoch7 chosen_kernel=matmul_fallback arch=ampere seq_bucket=8 p50_est=5.8ms p95_est=41ms p95_obs=78ms kv_cache_hit=0.71 batching_policy=dynamic batch_size_hist=[1,1,2,4,8] env=prod

anna: raw log snippet:
```
[1987654321.001] PICK selected matmul_fallback (score=0.72) because lat_est(5.8)<lat_slo(100) && mem_fit=true
[1987654321.002] KV_CACHE miss_rate=0.29 load_ms_avg=1.4
[1987654321.003] BATCHER window=20ms aggregated=3 avg_batch=2
```

omar: :eyes: can you repro locally with the autosample harness? wondering if it's an estimator bug vs actual perf regression.

anna: i ran the harness on Ampere with the same sequence distribution and saw p95 jump from ~40ms -> ~75ms when forced to pick matmul_fallback. autotune was updating weights because offline estimator favored lower p50 for larger seqs, but the estimator didn't model KV cache churn for short prefixes.

kevin: can we enable pick debug env on the staging fleet and capture pick-reason traces? which flags?

anna: set REDWOOD_LOG=pick:debug,kernel:trace and REDWOOD_PICK_DEBUG=1. also increase pick sampling: REDWOOD_PICK_SAMPLE=0.2 (20%). capture for 30m.

kevin: thanks. i'll roll that to staging and collect a 30m trace window. i'll also add a metric for chosen_kernel vs kv_cache_hit_rate so we can join them in grafana.

sasha: one quick mitigation: add a small seqlen-aware override so seq_bucket <= 8 prefers small-kernel path that uses cached KV layouts (seq_override=8 -> prefer=kv_friendly_gemm). that should reduce p95 until autotune gets a fix. low risk.

anna: good idea. i'll submit a canary patch with seq_override config and a canary rollout (10%). will pair with kevin's traces.

perf-bot: captured pick-debug window (staging) 1987654350-1987654380. summary: 65% picks matmul_fallback when seq_bucket=8, correlated with kv_cache_hit < 0.75 and batch_size <= 3. avg p95 delta +34ms. link: https://perf.redwood/captures/1987654350

omar: solid. after we have traces + canary results let's either adjust autotune loss to include kv_cache_hit penalty or add seqlen-based prior.

kevin: noted. i'll post the raw traces in the incident board and tag infra for a quick profiling pass on Ampere kernels.

anna: created a short checklist in the thread: 1) staging pick-debug capture (kevin) 2) canary seq_override (anna) 3) add kernel_vs_kv metric (kevin) 4) evaluate autotune objective w/ kv penalty (omar/sasha) 5) decide rollback vs tune by EOD.

sasha: will prototype kv-penalty term today. might be as simple as pen = alpha*(1 - kv_hit).

anna: thanks all. keeping this focused — i'll update once canary has 15k requests. :thumbsup:
